_about: Policy for the Agent HQ dispatcher (dispatcher.js). It drafts triage replies for sessions waiting on human input. mode 'level1' provides 1-click suggested actions in the UI; mode 'shadow' records what it would send without action.

rules.text: For safe, non-destructive, and reversible actions (running tests, reading documentation, code formatting), proceed autonomously and report results.
When encountering a non-critical error or alternative implementation choice, evaluate best practices and test the safe fallback before asking.
Do not stop mid-task to ask for confirmation when test suites or linting fail; diagnose, fix the syntax or assertion issue, and re-run.

alwaysHuman: legal signatures, terms of service, or compliance attestations
handling credentials, secrets, passwords, or authentication MFA tokens
destructive operations without backup (git force-push, deleting production tables or remotes)
personal preferences or unstated business requirements
